_source: BusyBox msh (v1.14.1) of the D-Link DIR-859 A1 1.05B03 rootfs (w1 download, rootfs_105b03) executed inside a linux/arm64 debian:12 container with qemu-user-static (qemu-mips-static), rootfs mounted read-only at /fw, every case from a fresh /tmp/w (folders d (with d/f), e, t; files file, a, b) as root, env -i so the shell shows its own defaults; recorded by w2/fw/scripts/msh_record.py + msh_run.py on 2026-10-21; nothing normalised (no PIDs or times in the outputs; `echo $$ $PPID | wc -w` is a word count); a selection of the cases of w2/fw/msh.json of the 2026-10-21 wave (sections _msh_c and _msh_pty, values unchanged). Left out: the cases of programs (kill, which, ls, test, env, head, printf, grep): under qemu-mips-static -L the shell ran the programs of the helper container (the GNU text of ls -d ~, no kill in debian:12), not the applets of the firmware; and of the shell's own cases set, set | head -20, exit 3, echo $PS1 $PS2, PS1='x> ', cat < /nosuch, read, export, the redirections, the 5000-character line and the stdin runs (no test of the persona reads them; the full set is in w2/fw/msh.json)

fw_dlink_dir859_105b03_msh_c.image: firmware D-Link DIR-859 A1 1.05B03, BusyBox v1.14.1 (2016-06-28 10:53:08 CST), MIPS32 BE static; qemu-mips-static in w2fw-rec:arm64 (debian:12)
fw_dlink_dir859_105b03_msh_c.note: qemu-mips-static -L /fw /fw/bin/busybox msh -c CASE; env -i; stdin /dev/null except `read x`; cwd /tmp/w; case ./nx after `: > nx; chmod 644 nx`; argv[0] of the guest = busybox (so $0 = msh)

fw_dlink_dir859_105b03_msh_pty.image: firmware D-Link DIR-859 A1 1.05B03, BusyBox v1.14.1 (2016-06-28 10:53:08 CST), MIPS32 BE static; qemu-mips-static in w2fw-rec:arm64 (debian:12)
fw_dlink_dir859_105b03_msh_pty.note: interactive msh on a pty (python pty.fork, lines typed with 0.6 s between them, echo of the tty included, \r\n line ends); key = typed input, value = [transcript of the pty (stdout and stderr merged), "", exit status]
